listings.current_description: Stafix - Electric Fence & Security Centre is the Southern African distributor of imported and locally-manufactured electric fence energizers, based in Kloofsig, also supplying CCTV, alarm systems, electric locks, perimeter mesh and taut-wire fencing and gate automation, alongside accredited electric-fence and CCTV training.

Africa is the South African office of Stratus Technologies, a global provider of fault-tolerant computing systems - including its ztC Endurance and ztC Edge platforms and everRun software - built for continuous availability in mission-critical applications, based at Lynnwood Bridge.

listings.name: T-Mac projects
listings.current_description: T-Mac Projects is a construction company in Klerksoord, Pretoria, specialising in alternative building methods including wendy houses, Nutec fibre-cement structures and timber log homes, along with custom designs, installation and repairs, aiming to complete builds faster and more affordably than traditional brick construction.

listings.address: 1st Floor, Oxford Office Park, 3 Bauhinia St, Building 28, Highveld Techno Park, Pretoria, 0140
listings.current_description: The 13th Check Business Services provides outsourced payroll and HR administration -- including payslips, leave management, statutory submissions, IRP5/IT3 certificates and COIDA reporting -- alongside HR services such as employment equity planning and policy development, from offices in Centurion and Cape Town.

listings.name: The garden group
listings.current_description: The garden group is a landscape design and construction company with 37 years' experience, offering garden maintenance, tree trimming and felling, irrigation system installation and invasive plant control, with a focus on water-wise, indigenous planting for golf estates, office parks and residential clients.

listings.name: The Pretoria Treefelling Guru & Emergency Tree Service 24/7
listings.current_description: The Pretoria Treefelling Guru & Emergency Tree Service 24/7 offers tree felling, pruning, stump removal and storm-damage clean-up across Pretoria and Centurion, plus site and plot clearing, rubble removal and instant lawn installation, with dedicated emergency tree-felling services available around the clock.

listings.name: Think Smart Built-In Systems
listings.current_description: Think Smart Built-In Systems is a specialist supplier and installer of central vacuum systems for homes, offices and commercial buildings in Die Wilgers, offering both dry and wet-and-dry systems from brands such as Drainvac and Hayden Super Vac, plus installation and after-sales support.

listings.name: Unique Flooring
listings.address: Shop 2B, Centurion Crescent Shopping Centre, Zwartkop, Centurion, 0157
listings.current_description: Unique Flooring is a flooring specialist in Centurion Crescent Shopping Centre that has traded since 1997, supplying and installing laminate, vinyl and engineered wood flooring plus wall cladding from brands including Kronotex, Kronoswiss, Egger and Classen, with a five-year workmanship warranty on installations.

listings.name: varsity lodge
listings.current_description: Varsity Lodge (Lynnwood Varsity Lodge) is secure student accommodation in Brooklyn, Pretoria, about 250m from the University of Pretoria, offering 92 units of five, six or seven bedrooms sharing a lounge, dining room and kitchen, with basement parking, on-site laundry and wireless internet.

listings.name: VBKOM
listings.current_description: VBKOM is a mining and geological consulting engineering firm based in Clubview, Centurion, offering mineral-resource estimation, exploration, financial modelling and project support to the mining sector across Africa, Australia and Canada, with a focus on commodities such as diamonds, platinum-group metals and coal.

listings.name: Vertex Automation
listings.current_description: Vertex Automation is a Weavind Park industrial-automation integrator that designs, fabricates and installs custom conveyor systems, Fanuc robotics for pick-and-place and palletising, and complete automated production lines with PLC, HMI and control-system integration for manufacturing, automotive, food and beverage, packaging and pharmaceutical clients.

listings.name: YoungByte
listings.address: 1911 Villa Casia, Bokmakierie St, Theresapark, Pretoria, 0182
listings.current_description: YoungByte, based in Theresapark, is a technology consultancy with more than 14 years in operation, offering systems modernisation consulting, a skills academy, software platforms for school management, savings groups and church administration, and digital presence services including web design and social media management.

listings.name: Accolade Consulting
listings.address: Unit 31, NORMA JEAN SQUARE, 244 Jean Ave, Die Hoewes, Centurion, 0157
listings.current_description: Accolade Consulting is a Level 2 BBBEE-rated IT services company with 23 years of experience, providing Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Power BI and SQL Server implementation, custom application development, network infrastructure and security systems such as CCTV and access control from its Die Hoewes office.

listings.name: ANEW Hotels & Resorts Head Office and Central Reservations
listings.address: Corner Gordon Hood Road, Hendrik Verwoerd Dr, and, Centurion, 0157

listings.name: ANH Technologies (PTY) Ltd
listings.current_description: ANH Technologies is a solar energy equipment supplier based in Koedoespoort, and the appointed South African importer and distributor for brands including SMA, BYD and Renusol, supplying battery and inverter solutions such as the SMA Sunny Island system to installers, wholesalers and large-scale projects.

listings.name: AO Group
listings.current_description: AO Group is a Level 1 BEE-rated technology and digital transformation company, founded in South Africa in 2016, offering enterprise software engineering, AI, cloud, managed ICT and business advisory services from its Lynnwood Glen office, with additional operations across Kenya, Botswana, Zambia and Mauritius.

listings.name: ASHTON GROUP
listings.address: Ashton Hse, 51 Lebombo Rd, Ashlea Park, Pretoria, 0002
listings.current_description: Ashton Group is a Pretoria-based accounting and auditing firm with roots in the Robberts Marais Chartered Accountants practice, formally established as the Ashton CA (SA) Group in 2005, providing financial, accounting and auditing services to private, owner-driven businesses with a staff of about 20.

listings.name: Astron Energy Eldoraigne Boulevard
listings.current_description: Astron Energy Eldoraigne Boulevard is a fuel station in Eldoraigne, Centurion, part of the Astron Energy network -- the brand that has been rebranding South Africa's former Caltex service stations since 2021, after Astron Energy took over the Caltex licence from Chevron in 2018.

listings.name: ATC Innovations (Pty) Ltd
listings.current_description: ATC Innovations is an automation systems company established in 2008 in Rosslyn East, designing and manufacturing turnkey automated materials-handling and special-purpose machines for the automotive, chemical, mining, palletising and food & beverage industries; the company is also an authorised Ingersoll Rand Power Tools distributor.

listings.name: Bigradap Group Technologies (PTY) LTD
listings.address: 31, 3 Bauhinia St, Highveld Techno Park, Centurion, 0169
listings.current_description: Bigradap Group Technologies is an IT company at Highveld Techno Park providing customised ICT solutions to public and private sector clients across Africa, including security, capacity planning, business continuity and disaster recovery services, and also operates a branch in the Democratic Republic of Congo.

listings.name: Blackboard Business Intelligence
listings.current_description: Blackboard Business Intelligence is a data analytics firm serving the mining, retail, oil & gas, insurance, utilities and banking sectors, and is a global partner of Hitachi Energy and Mincom for BI solutions on platforms including SAP, Microsoft Power BI, Oracle and Tibco Jaspersoft.

listings.name: Bothongo Group Management
listings.address: Bothongo Plaza West, 271 Francis Baard St, Pretoria, 0002
listings.current_description: Bothongo Group Management provides property management services at Bothongo Plaza West, a 17-storey office building at 271 Francis Baard St, Pretoria, on behalf of the wider Bothongo Group, which develops commercial and residential property and operates subsidiaries in hospitality, agriculture, IT, construction and aviation.

listings.name: Bridal Wardrobe
listings.address: Shop 8, Lynnwood Bridge Retail, Cnr Lynnwood and Daventry Road, Lynnwood Manor, Pretoria, 0081
listings.current_description: Bridal Wardrobe was an upmarket bridal boutique at Lynnwood Bridge specialising in the sale and hire of Enzoani, Elysee and Pen.Liv wedding gowns and accessories. After roughly 12 years at Lynnwood Bridge, it relocated to a new boutique in Menlo Park in 2025.

listings.name: Busines Academy Southern Africa (BASA)
listings.current_description: Busines Academy Southern Africa (BASA) is a training and consulting firm operating since 2011, offering public short courses, certified professional programs, in-house training, and online eLearning in fields such as HR, accounting, IT security, project management, and supply chain management for organisations across Africa.

listings.current_description: Bvumbi Ready Mix's head office is based at Hazeldean Office Park on Silverlakes Road, Pretoria; the company is a black-owned, youth-led ready-mix concrete supplier founded in 2019, supplying concrete grades from 10 MPa to 60 MPa and offering concrete pumping and free site inspections.

listings.name: Car Service City - Montana
listings.current_description: Car Service City - Montana is a branch of the Car Service City vehicle repair chain, offering major and minor services, repairs and genuine parts replacement for all makes and models, including a complimentary 62-point safety inspection. The branch is RMI and MIWA accredited.

listings.name: Cardiff Capital
listings.current_description: Cardiff Capital is a registered financial services provider and life insurance broker house based in Erasmusrand, Pretoria, operating since 2005. It offers life, disability, income protection and severe illness cover, retirement and investment planning for individuals and small-to-medium businesses, plus a short-term insurance division.

listings.name: CEC

listings.current_description: CEC (Centurion Enquiry Chambers) is a meeting venue in Lyttletown Office Park, Centurion, purpose-built for insolvency inquiries and business rescue meetings, with boardroom facilities, recording equipment, free Wi-Fi, and catering available on request. Its main venue, the Bench Chamber, seats up to 30 people.

listings.current_description: An estate management and security software company based in De Wilgers, Pretoria, providing a platform used by managers and security teams at residential estates and gated communities, covering visitor and contractor management, license-plate recognition, biometric and facial-recognition access control, and a resident mobile app.

listings.name: Company @ The Ready
listings.current_description: Company @ The Ready is a business registration and compliance consultancy in Lynnwood Glen, Pretoria, offering company registration packages, tax and B-BBEE registrations, Workmen's Compensation and UIF registrations, share transfers and company conversions, and partners with an audit firm for bookkeeping and tender preparation services.

listings.name: COMPUPORT

listings.name: CoreMet Mineral Processing
listings.current_description: CoreMet Mineral Processing is a Pretoria-based mineral processing technology company offering dry and wet processing equipment and services for heavy minerals, gold, PGMs, diamonds, and coal, including its Multi Gravity Separators, Kroosh Screens, and Virto Screens, along with metallurgical testing and ore characterization services.

listings.name: Corporate Coffee Solutions - Coffee Machines Pretoria
listings.current_description: Corporate Coffee Solutions is a commercial coffee machine supplier with a Pretoria branch in Magalieskruin, providing bean-to-cup, espresso, filter, and capsule coffee machines on rental, lease, or purchase terms, along with freshly roasted coffee, barista training, and technical support, serving South Africa and Namibia.

listings.name: Cosave Powerbuild & Wholesalers Pretoria
listings.current_description: Cosave PowerBuild & Wholesalers is an owner-managed DIY and hardware store in Kirkney, Pretoria, stocking power tools, home and garden supplies, paint, plumbing and electrical fixtures, PPE, and solar power products, and states on its website that it is open 363 days a year.

listings.name: Digitalworld

listings.name: Drive Dynamics
listings.current_description: Drive Dynamics is an electrical, control and instrumentation engineering company established in 2002 and based in Hennopspark, Centurion, supplying variable speed drives, solar inverters and panels, electric motors, soft starters and custom electrical control panels to agricultural, industrial, commercial and mining clients across Africa.

listings.name: Dros
listings.current_description: Dros is a South African restaurant and wine cellar chain; this branch is located at the corner of Jean and Lenchen Streets in Centurion. Dros restaurants are typically open Monday to Sunday from 08:00 to 23:00, though hours may vary by branch.

listings.name: DST Printing
listings.current_description: DST Printing is a family-owned print shop in Wierdapark, Centurion, with over 16 years in the industry, offering embroidery, DTF (direct-to-film) printing, pad printing, heat transfers, stationery and gift printing, 3D printing and laser cutting from both a physical shop and an online store.

listings.name: Famous Brands Coffee Company (Pty) Ltd
listings.current_description: Famous Brands Coffee Company is a coffee roasting and sourcing business based in Hennopspark, roasting beans in South Africa since 2007 and supplying coffee to brands including Mugg & Bean, Vovo Telo, Wimpy and Lupa Osteria; its facility holds FSSC 22000 food safety accreditation.

listings.current_description: Grace Water Solutions, headquartered in Zwavelpoort, provides industrial water treatment and plant operations for the potable water, automotive, food and beverage, mining, gas and bottled-water industries, offering on-site support, custom plant designs and SANAS-accredited laboratory services; its operating company is Level 2 BBBEE accredited.

listings.name: HD Telecoms
listings.current_description: HD Telecoms is a telecommunications and IT provider headquartered in Zwartkop, Centurion, running a 3CX-based Cloud PBX voice platform with unlimited voice lines and a VoIP mobile app, alongside broader connectivity, IT support and backup services, with additional branches in Johannesburg and Cape Town.

listings.name: Life Eugene Marais Hospital
listings.current_description: Life Eugene Marais Hospital is a 364-bed private hospital with 14 theatres, including a hybrid theatre and cathlab, an ICU, a neonatal ICU, a 24-hour accident and emergency unit and a 12-bed maternity unit, and is well known for its neurosurgical and orthopaedic surgery.
